preconditions.description: Attacker must have DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE (owner) or be able to obtain it through setRoleSuperAdmin function
Contract must have some FIT token balance for the attacker to steal

exploit_hint: As the contract owner (DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE), grant yourself MINTER_ROLE using grantRole function, then call mint to create arbitrary tokens for your address. Alternatively, if you control BOSS_CONTROL_ROLE, set addressForBosses to your address and call withDraw to transfer all contract tokens to yourself. You can also use setRoleSuperAdmin to transfer ownership to another address you control.
